Process

How a Karachi project runs

1

Tell us about the space

Call, WhatsApp or email with drawings, photos or a rough idea. We shape the brief together.

2

Site visit or drawings review

We visit the site on a scheduled round from Lahore, or work from your drawings.

3

Concept & quantities

You see the design in 3D and approve itemized quantities before anything is built.

4

Build & handover

One team delivers the work and hands over a finished space that matches what you approved.

A local note

A note on working in Karachi

Karachi is the commercial capital, and most of our work here is retail, office and hospitality fit-outs. Projects are run from our Lahore studio in scheduled phases, with site visits planned around each stage. We do not keep an office in Karachi, so timelines are agreed before work begins and held to.
